reason: Version 4 keeps the facts and the commitments about history, a future worth caring for, privilege, restoring each instrument’s voice, and bringing music into homes, adding only a slight “back.” Version 3 paraphrases those commitments closely but drops the founder title; version 1 keeps the facts yet replaces privilege, voice, and bringing music with different claims; version 2 adds “most” and “old” and rewrites the future, privilege, and homes commitments.
